# ChartSeries

Describes one declarative chart data series.

```html
<noora-chart-series type="line"><noora-chart-point value="2"></noora-chart-point><noora-chart-point value="5"></noora-chart-point></noora-chart-series>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type or allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | None | Sets the series name. |
| `type` | `bar`, `line` | `"line"` | Chooses the series visualization. |
| `symbol` | `string` | None | Sets the symbol used for line-series points. |
| `bar-width` | `number` | None | Sets the width of bars. |
| `bar-gap` | `string` | None | Sets the gap between bar series. |
| `border-radius` | `number` | None | Rounds bar corners. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Declarative noora-chart-point children. |

Use this element inside noora-chart.

## Series

Describe one line series.

```html
<noora-chart-series type="line"><noora-chart-point value="2"></noora-chart-point><noora-chart-point value="5"></noora-chart-point></noora-chart-series>
```
